* No black-bordered card with Decipher's exact wording exists yet. The Players Committee has not made a D-E1 card for it.
* Decipher's [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Reflections Foil)|Reflections foil]] (12 January 2000) prints a related text, not these exact words. It prints a reworded intermediate text: 'If Vader and Obi-Wan are present at same site, use 1 Force to initiate a duel between them. Either Jedi is power +2 if they have a lightsaber. Loser of duel is out of play.' Shares 'present' and 'duel' changes with the errata but not the errata's comparison wording ('Compare their power, and add 2 if that character is armed with a lightsaber. Loser (lowest total) of duel is placed out of play.').

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text only in the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002). Decipher never printed a card with this wording.
